extracted.name: Slow Cooker Ham with Pineapple
extracted.description: This slow cooker ham with pineapple uses a can of cola to create a tender, juicy, and delicious Easter ham that’s sure to please all your guests.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15.25 ounce) can pineapple rings, juice drained and reserved
1 (16 ounce) can cola-flavored carbonated beverage (such as Pepsi®)
instruction_lines: Place ham in slow cooker with the fattier side facing down. Use toothpicks to attach pineapple rings to the ham; pour over pineapple juice. Pour cola into the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 to 10 hours.
